## Mission
Verify ERC, DRC, BOM/CPL/Gerber consistency, MCU pins, physical mating, fault shutdowns, ECU firmware tests, 4D parity, Python tests, thermal/EMC and bench waveforms. Block unsupported production claims.

## Acceptance

Update your task brief with PR link, test reports and remaining blockers.
